additional_info.subject: ID0421503-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / PD 170001311] TDK issue CRM:00642002241
additional_info.body:
Hello Rasmus,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
GodEnergi A/S
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / PD 170001311
Charger ID/Serial No.:
fuUDRK
Problem Description:
TDK issue
As per your reported issue, we have analyzed and found that the contactor has been in an abnormal operation state multiple time.
Please check the QA09-10 contactor and proceed with the replacement if necessary.
Additionally, a new feature has been implemented in the charger firmware for the self-check test of contactor operations.
For detailed information on how the test is performed, please follow the link in the wiki:
Matrix Contactors/Coils Self Test - EV Charger Development - Confluence (siemens.cloud)
As per the fault code of the error:
Contactors in group 0 failed the test, and groups 1, 2, and 3 tests were skipped.
Adding to the information provided earlier:
Status:
failed,
Reason:
smc[0,1,2,3]-[states]-[results]
Status:
failed,
Reason:
smc[0,1,2,3]-[P,P,P,S]-[0,0,0,0] : in charger
So, the details are as follows:
SMC0: QA9/QA10
SMC1: QA11/QA12
SMC2: QA17/QA18
SMC3: QA15/QA16
In the error code status [F,S,S,S], it denotes that the SMC0 contactor check failed, and SMC1, 2, and 3 were skipped. The [0,0,0,0] denotes that the feedback for contactor QA9/QA10 was not received.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [
Fill in date manually
], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Mohini Patil
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it
